tasks.summary_en: Cars from A and B (474km) meet 300km from B. Find speeds
tasks.statement_en: The road from town A to town B is 474 km long. A car traveling from A to B sets off one hour later than a car traveling from B to A. These cars meet at a distance of 300 km from town B. The average speed of the car that left town A, measured from its departure to the moment of meeting, was 17 km/h less than the average speed of the other car, measured from its departure from B to the moment of meeting. Compute the average speed of each car up to the moment of meeting.
tasks.notes: Official key gives two mathematically valid solution pairs: (vA=51,vB=68) and (vA=58,vB=75) from a quadratic with two roots satisfying all constraints. Value uses the first-listed pair; game value is inherently ambiguous here. [verified: exclude: 17t^2-143t+300=0 gives t=4 or 75/17, both valid; key accepts both pairs (51,68) and (58,75). Sums 119 vs 133 - ambiguous.]
